Package io.github._3xhaust.dsl.widgets

Class ButtonWidget

java.lang.Object
io.github._3xhaust.dsl.AbstractWidget<ButtonWidget>
io.github._3xhaust.dsl.widgets.ButtonWidget
All Implemented Interfaces:
View, Widget
public final class ButtonWidget extends AbstractWidget<ButtonWidget>
Material-flavored button with three variants:
  • ButtonWidget.Variant.FILLED - default, primary background.
  • ButtonWidget.Variant.OUTLINED - transparent with primary border.
  • ButtonWidget.Variant.TEXT - flat, primary foreground.
